phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Mossberg 590A1 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 74 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 74 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 508 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the smooth bore and accelerates to 405 m/s (3180 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Twin-Bar Pump & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, dual action bars draw the slide carrier rearward to drop the locking block and lift the next shell.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 8-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Mossberg 590A1 staged for its 35 RPM (manual pump) cadence.

zh.headline: 莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪：1961 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 莫斯伯格 590A1 是唯一通过美国军方 MIL-S-3443G 3,000 发全威力独头弹/鹿弹严苛测试的泵动霰弹枪：加厚枪管、铝合金扳机护圈与机匣顶置对称拇指保险成就了美军舰船登临与破门铁壁标准。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Mossberg 590A1 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1961 年问世的 莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪 由美国奥·福·莫斯伯格父子公司（O.F. Mossberg & Sons）主导研制，定位为经典的军规双连杆泵动霰弹枪。莫斯伯格 500 族自 1961 年问世以来累计产量突破 1,100 万支，590A1 型因可抵御海军钢制水密门撞击而被美国海军与陆战队长期列装。
莫斯伯格 590A1 是唯一通过美国军方 MIL-S-3443G 3,000 发全威力独头弹/鹿弹严苛测试的泵动霰弹枪：加厚枪管、铝合金扳机护圈与机匣顶置对称拇指保险成就了美军舰船登临与破门铁壁标准。 整件装备总长 1,041 mm（41.0 in）、空重 3.29 kg，成为同期霰弹枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1961 年，美国奥·福·莫斯伯格父子公司（O.F. Mossberg & Sons）推出了划时代的莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪。莫斯伯格 500 族自 1961 年问世以来累计产量突破 1,100 万支，590A1 型因可抵御海军钢制水密门撞击而被美国海军与陆战队长期列装。 它的核心设计聚焦于唯一通过美军 MIL-S-3443G 三千发严苛耐力考核的军规泵动霰弹枪，奠定了其在霰弹枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪 的机械灵魂在于其「双拉杆泵动上倾闭锁 · 顶部拇指保险 · 开放式托弹板」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，护木双联动拉杆向后拉动枪机托架使闭锁楔块降落，完成抽抛与托弹上膛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。双拉杆对称驱动与双抽壳钩设计彻底杜绝泥沙卡壳与偏磨，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪 采用双拉杆泵动上倾闭锁 · 顶部拇指保险 · 开放式托弹板。在每个击发周期中，护木双联动拉杆向后拉动枪机托架使闭锁楔块降落，完成抽抛与托弹上膛。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了双拉杆对称驱动与双抽壳钩设计彻底杜绝泥沙卡壳与偏磨。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) 弹药规格与 508 mm（20 in 加厚壁军规磷化滑膛枪管 · 刺刀座），最高工作膛压约 74 MPa，可赋予弹头 405 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,180 J 动能，有效作用距离达 45 米。
内膛技术特点方面，18.5 mm 加厚壁圆柱喉缩滑膛身管，抗舰船钢门磕碰变形。同时，装填时托弹板保持高位开启，戴厚重战术手套仍可顺畅压弹，令其在 35 发/分（手动泵动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 508 毫米身管与 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) 口径，莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪 实现了每秒 405 米的初速与 45 米有效射程。18.5 mm 加厚壁圆柱喉缩滑膛身管，抗舰船钢门磕碰变形，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 8 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与 36 mm 膛轴设计，莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 22.8 N·s 水平。机匣顶部对称拇指保险 + 底部金属扳机座 + 舰船防撞加厚枪管。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-75）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 8 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与出色的整体工效，机匣顶部对称拇指保险 + 底部金属扳机座 + 舰船防撞加厚枪管。欢迎在 BAY-75 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 莫斯伯格 590A1 军规泵动霰弹枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Mossberg 590A1
paragraphs: Introduced in 1961 by O.F. Mossberg & Sons in United States, the Mossberg 590A1 MIL-SPEC Shotgun emerged as a defining Military Pump-Action Shotgun. With over 11 million Model 500-series guns produced since 1961, the heavy-barreled 590A1 became standard issue for US Navy shipboard security and Marine breachers.

The only pump shotgun to pass the US military MIL-S-3443G 3,000-round full-power buckshot endurance trial, the Mossberg 590A1 pairs a heavy-walled barrel, metal trigger guard, twin extractors, and an ambidextrous tang safety for naval boarding and breaching. Measuring 1,041 mm (41.0 in) at an unloaded weight of 3.29 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Combat Shotgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1961, O.F. Mossberg & Sons of United States introduced the Mossberg 590A1 MIL-SPEC Shotgun. With over 11 million Model 500-series guns produced since 1961, the heavy-barreled 590A1 became standard issue for US Navy shipboard security and Marine breachers. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Sole pump shotgun certified under the US MIL-S-3443G 3,000-round torture standard — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Mossberg 590A1 MIL-SPEC Shotgun sits its Twin Action-Bar Pump Tilting-Bolt · Tang Safety · Clear-Path Elevator. Throughout every firing cycle, dual action bars draw the slide carrier rearward to drop the locking block and lift the next shell, containing 74 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Twin action bars and dual steel extractors prevent binding under heavy fouling, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Mossberg 590A1 MIL-SPEC Shotgun relies on Twin Action-Bar Pump Tilting-Bolt · Tang Safety · Clear-Path Elevator. During each cycle, dual action bars draw the slide carrier rearward to drop the locking block and lift the next shell. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Twin action bars and dual steel extractors prevent binding under heavy fouling.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) with 508 mm (20 in Heavy-Walled MIL-SPEC Parkerized Smoothbore), the Mossberg 590A1 MIL-SPEC Shotgun develops 405 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,180 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 45 meters.

Internally, 18.5 mm heavy-walled cylinder-bore smoothbore engineered to survive naval bulkhead impacts. Combined with its 35 RPM (manual pump) tempo, Up-stowed elevator clears the loading port for smooth gloved shell insertion, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) through its 508 millimeter bore, the Mossberg 590A1 MIL-SPEC Shotgun achieves 405 meters per second and 45 meters of effective reach. 18.5 mm heavy-walled cylinder-bore smoothbore engineered to survive naval bulkhead impacts.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 8-round under-barrel tubular magazine with a 36 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 22.8 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Ambidextrous top-tang safety paired with aluminum trigger housing and heavy barrel.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-75), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
